g.text: Where does the linear RO miss the observed evolution?
The consecutive La Niña mismatch grows in July–December; both Niño3.4 and WWV contribute.
Shading: July–December. Dotted segments: half-year RMS vector mismatch. Rates are derivatives of the monthly composites.
Continuous monthly derivatives are calculated before compositing; no artificial December-to-January closure is imposed.
A residual can include omitted forcing, noise and coefficient error; it does not by itself identify nonlinear dynamics.
